patterns.note: Alternating two-column layout for feature sections, with images and text blocks swapping sides to create visual rhythm.
Dominant dark charcoal background (#181818) with high-contrast white text, accented by a vibrant red in the hero section.
Prominent, large sans-serif headings for section titles, paired with a clean, legible body text for details and benefits.
A persistent sticky header containing the brand logo and navigation remains fixed at the top of the viewport, allowing page content to scroll underneath it.
Accordion-style interactive elements are used for the FAQ section, allowing users to expand and collapse answers.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero image features aspirational photography set against a strong brand color background, with large, contrasting white text overlayed for impact.
Content sections utilize a dark background with white typography, employing a two-column grid that alternates the placement of images and descriptive text for visual engagement.

A fixed header bar containing the brand logo and primary navigation elements is present from the top of the page and remains sticky at the top of the viewport, allowing main content to scroll beneath it without obscuring navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, paired with legible regular-weight body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (minimal rounding on interactive elements, otherwise sharp edges for content blocks).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced (comfortable padding around elements and sections, providing clear separation without feeling overly dense or airy).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, dark background combined with high-contrast white typography and vibrant, aspirational photography creates a premium and focused brand experience. The seamless visual integration of two distinct brands (Lululemon Studio and Peloton) is particularly well-executed.
